estimates.assumptions: Standard sea bass fillet is ~120g each (edible portion, skin-on); 6 fillets total 720g. Typical value for raw sea bass is ~97 kcal/100g.
A 'large knob' of ginger is estimated at 30g peeled weight, typical for this style of recipe.
Average garlic clove is 3g; 3 cloves = 9g total. Matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
3 large red chillies estimated at ~40g each (edible portion after deseeding/shredding) = 120g total. Matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
A 'bunch' of spring onions is typically 100g once trimmed and shredded. Matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
